title: Bug:  test_dhcp_relay_default fails in verify_relayed_advertise — DUT cannot resolve client link-local after NDP cache is cleared by setup_downstream_relay_responder
author: fzjalfred
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

After PR #23432 merged, test_dhcp_relay_default in test_dhcpv6_relay.py fails at the verify_relayed_advertise() step. The PTF client port does not receive the expected DHCPv6 Advertise packet from the DUT.



### Steps to Reproduce

Run test_dhcpv6_relay.py -k test_dhcp_relay_default

The test flow in test_dhcp_relay_default is:
1. Call setup_downstream_relay_responder() — this configures PTF's arp_responder to answer NDP for the simulated downstream relay IP (fc02:ffff::1), and then calls sonic-clear ndp on the DUT.
2. Run ptf_runner with dhcpv6_relay_test.DHCPTest.
3. Inside DHCPTest.runTest(), the PTF client sends a DHCPv6 Solicit, the DUT relays it to the server, and the server (PTF) sends back an Advertise inside a Relay-Reply.
4. The DUT needs to forward the Advertise back to the client's link-local address. However, since sonic-clear ndp was called in step 1, the DUT's NDP cache no longer has the client's link-local entry.
5. The DUT sends a Neighbor Solicitation to resolve the client's link-local address, but PTF's arp_responder is only configured with the downstream relay IP (fc02:ffff::1) — it does not respond to NS for the client's link-local address.
6. The DUT never gets a Neighbor Advertisement, so the Advertise packet is never forwarded to the client port.
7. verify_relayed_advertise() → verify_packet() times out → test fails.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Actual Behavior
The PTF client port does not receive the DHCPv6 Advertise packet. Instead, only NDP Neighbor Solicitation and MLD Report packets are observed on the client port. The DUT is trying to resolve the client's link-local address via NDP but never receives a Neighbor Advertisement reply, so the Advertise is never forwarded. The test fails with:
AssertionError: Expected packet was not received on device 0, port 0.

Expected Behavior
The DUT receives a DHCPv6 Advertise inside a Relay-Reply from the server, decapsulates it, and forwards the Advertise to the client's link-local address on the VLAN port. The PTF client port should receive the DHCPv6 Advertise packet, and verify_relayed_advertise() should pass.

linkedPullRequests.title: Fix client ndp respond missing after responder reconfig
linkedPullRequests.author: fzjalfred
linkedPullRequests.body: ### Description of PR Summary: `test_dhcp_relay_default` (and other DHCPv6 relay tests) in `test_dhcpv6_relay.py` fail at `verify_relayed_advertise()` because the DUT cannot resolve the client's link-local address after `setup_downstream_relay_responder()` clears the NDP cache. The `setup_ptf_ip_responder()` helper (introduced by #23432) calls `sonic-clear ndp` on the DUT, which destroys all NDP entries including the client's link-local. When the DUT subsequently tries to forward the DHCPv6 Advertise back to the client, it sends a Neighbor Solicitation that PTF never answers (PTF's `arp_responder` is only configured for the downstream relay IP, not the client link-local), so the Advertise is never delivered and the test times out. This PR adds a call to `ensure_client_reachability()` after `setup_ptf_ip_responder()` in `setup_downstream_relay_responder()`, which re-establishes the client's NDP entry on the DUT so it can resolve the client link-local address when relaying DHCPv6 Advertise/Reply packets. Fixes #27452 ### Type of change - [x] Bug fix - [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement) - [ ] New Test case - [ ] Skipped for non-supported platforms - [ ] Test case improvement ### Back port request - [ ] 202311 - [ ] 202405 - [ ] 202411 - [ ] 202505 - [ ] 202511 - [ ] 202512 - [x] 202605 Tracking issue/work item for backport/cherry-pick request (GitHub issue or Microsoft ADO): https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/27452 Failure type: day-one-issue ### Tested branch - [x] master - [ ] 202311 - [ ] 202405 - [ ] 202411 - [ ] 202505 - [ ] 202511 - [ ] 202512 - [x] 202605 - [ ] N/A ### Test result For both master and 202605 ### Approach #### What is the motivation for this PR? After PR #23432 merged, `test_dhcp_relay_default` in `test_dhcpv6_relay.py` fails at the `verify_relayed_advertise()` step. The root cause is that `setup_downstream_relay_responder()` calls `sonic-clear ndp` on the DUT, which clears all NDP entries including the DHCPv6 client's link-local address. When the DUT tries to forward the DHCPv6 Advertise back to the client, it cannot resolve the client's link-local address via NDP because PTF's `arp_responder` is only configured for the downstream relay IP, not the client's link-local. #### How did you do it? Added a call to `ensure_client_reachability()` after `setup_ptf_ip_responder()` in `setup_downstream_relay_responder()`. This function sends a multicast ping (`ping6 ff02::1`) on the VLAN interface to re-discover all link-local neighbors, repopulating the DUT's NDP cache with the client's link-local address before the DHCPv6 test runs. #### How did you verify/test it? Ran `test_dhcpv6_relay.py::test_dhcp_relay_default` and verified the test passes. The DUT now correctly resolves the client's link-local address and forwards DHCPv6 Advertise packets back to the client. #### Any platform specific information? Any #### Supported testbed topology if it's a new test case? t0 ### Documentation N/A

comments.author: Xichen96
comments.body: The condition described here was already fixed by https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/26881. The responder setup now clears only the simulated relay's neighbor entry, leaving the client's link-local entry untouched. This PR is therefore no longer needed for the reported NDP-clearing issue.
